project_type: Vite + React 19 SPA, Tailwind CSS v4, single-page developer portfolio
build_system: Vite 8 with @vitejs/plugin-react. Tailwind v4 is installed but NOT wired into vite.config.js via the @tailwindcss/vite plugin — it is currently used only through global.css class names. No tailwind.config.js exists. Vite base is '/'. Proxy: /api -> http://localhost:5000.
test_framework: None — no test runner configured. Verification is done via npm run build (vite build).
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from the frontend directory. Build must exit 0 with no errors. Visual check: after `npm run preview`, the site loads, all sections visible, dark theme active, glassmorphism cards visible, animations work, language switcher switches text, contact form submits.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder generated by npm run build. Not checked in. No snapshot files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Do NOT restart any dev server. Do NOT touch backend/. No new npm packages allowed — all work must use existing deps: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, react-i18next, i18next, axios, lucide-react, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/vite. Tailwind v4 syntax: use @import 'tailwindcss' in CSS, NOT @tailwind base/components/utilities directives.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Key rule: after all changes, npm run build must pass with zero errors. Keep all existing content/data. Do not break auth/login flow, API integration in Contact, or i18n language switching.
key_patterns: 1) All styling is done in src/styles/global.css using CSS custom properties + class names (NO Tailwind utility classes in JSX currently — the project uses custom CSS class names like .btn, .section-container, etc.). 2) The Tailwind v4 package is installed but vite.config.js does NOT import @tailwindcss/vite plugin. To use Tailwind utilities in JSX, add the plugin to vite.config.js. 3) Components import styles indirectly via main.jsx -> global.css. 4) Dark theme: ThemeContext adds .dark class to html element; CSS uses html.dark selectors. 5) Sections use id= attributes for scroll-spy (home, about, skills, experience, projects, education, contact). 6) All section components live in src/components/. 7) App.jsx imports sections directly from components/ and assembles them. 8) Home.jsx simply re-exports App. 9) Hooks dir exists but useAuth.js is empty. Layouts dir exists but MainLayout.jsx is empty. 10) Assets: src/assets/selamsew.jpg (profile), src/assets/aau-logo.png. 11) Services.jsx imports '../components/Skills' which exists. AppRoutes.jsx imports pages/About.jsx and pages/Contact.jsx which exist.
directory_structure: frontend/src/ contains: api/ (axios.js), assets/ (selamsew.jpg, aau-logo.png), components/ (all section components + Navbar + Footer + Modal + LanguageSwitcher + SocialIcons + Skills + Frameworks + Languages + Loader), context/ (ThemeContext.jsx — has content; AuthContext.jsx — empty), data/ (portfolioData.js), hooks/ (useAuth.js — empty), i18n/ (i18n.js), layouts/ (MainLayout.jsx — empty), pages/ (Home, About, Contact, Services, Login, Dashboard), routes/ (AppRoutes.jsx), styles/ (global.css), utils/ (sound.js, helpers.js — likely empty, selam.jsx — unknown). Root: index.html, package.json, vite.config.js.
